prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1033; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and refrain from contacting our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Our client has been advised to make no statements to any adjuster or representative of your company without counsel present.

We request that you disclose the full liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, along with written confirmation of those limits.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, dash camera or surveillance footage, recorded statements, repair and appraisal records, and all internal notes and correspondence. Any destruction or alteration of such material could expose your insured and your company to serious consequences.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm within fourteen days that the preservation request has been implemented.
